reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN units >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS bulk_line_pct
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code
alternatives: SELECT store_code, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units >= 3) / COUNT(*), 1) AS bulk_line_pct FROM sales GROUP BY store_code
SELECT store_code, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN units >= 3 THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS bulk_line_pct FROM sales GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT store_code, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units >= 3) / COUNT(*), 1) AS bulk_line_pct FROM sales GROUP BY store_code
other_way.tradeoff: Reads closer to plain English, but FILTER is not available in every SQL dialect.
